findings.summary: The preserveReasoning default applies to every OmniRoute route, including cloud backends that may reject or bill for reasoning_content in assistant history. Confirm that OmniRoute strips or translates the field for non-reasoning providers, or scope the default to the reasoning combos.

Reasoning tokens and every earlier env snapshot (including the turn-1 file listing) now stay in context until condense, so condense will trigger sooner on long tasks. This is the accepted cached-token trade-off.

OmniRoute memory-context re-ranking and Lite compressToolResults truncation still diverge the prefix earlier than anything Zoo controls. Fix them in OmniRoute before measuring the ds4 live-KV hit rate.
